comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Tech Rank: 2
Consumed Gauge: 60
Range: 100
Shatter Range: 45

Requires 2 seconds before the activation.
With advanture job it requires just one second before the activation.

Effect:
Aside the damage, the target(s) get poisoned and loses -20 stamina per second. This last for at least 20 seconds and higher Trap prolongs the effect.
